narrative.overview: Renting a trailer is wayfinding: which yard, how long, what next. Sign green panels with a white keyline, numbered yard shields and arrows carry that idea; everything else is a calm white working surface built from standard controls.
keyCharacteristics: Sign green field with white inner keyline
Reflective yellow for the one primary action
Overpass route numerals for codes and money

rules.name: One Yellow Rule
rules.body: Reflective yellow marks only the primary action or current step.

rules.name: Route Numerals Rule
rules.body: Codes, money and times use Overpass extra-bold with tabular figures.

rules.name: Flat Sign Rule
rules.body: No gradients or decorative shadows; depth comes from the green field and hairlines.
